artworks.title: Departure for the Fields
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Various people are herding animals in the foreground, with a landscape visible beyond them. The horizon is positioned high in the image, showing a distant view of mountains or rolling hills near the top. Trees with intricate branches and foliage are centrally located, contrasting with the background landscape. The image is composed with detailed lines typical of etching or engraving, conveying texture and depth through cross-hatching and shading. The overall palette is monochrome, using varying shades of brown for contrast. On the right side, there is a structure resembling a rustic building on rocky terrain, connected to an arched bridge stretching over a small ravine.

artworks.title: Return of the Boats
artworks.description: The image shows sailboats with dark sails on the water. The horizon is visible, with boats meeting the sky. The color palette is monochrome in shades of tan and brown. The water has swirling lines, while the sky has abstract cloud formations.

artworks.title: L'Auteur fumant, à mi-corps
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated holding a pipe in his right hand, with his left hand resting on his lap. He wears a wide-brimmed hat covering curly, shoulder-length hair, and has distinctive facial features with a beard and mustache. He appears contemplative, looking slightly to his right. The man wears a coat with a high collar over a loose-fitting, ruffled shirt. The background is a textured, dark surface contrasting with the man's face and clothing, creating depth in this monochromatic depiction.

artworks.title: Man with a Scroll
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person from the back. They have thick, textured hair styled upwards, and their back is mostly exposed. The person's head is slightly turned to the side. Their left hand is seen holding a rolled-up object. The background includes hatching and shading. Texture is suggested by lines near the shoulder area. No jewelry or other objects are visible. The composition features dense cross-hatching for texture and shadow.

artworks.title: Peckham Rye
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape with a slight elevation showing a rustic structure and surrounding trees. The horizon is positioned toward the upper third, revealing a distant landscape and a line of trees. In the foreground, there is textured foliage, a small ditch, a weathered barn, and trees. Delicate brushstrokes and etched lines define the leaves and structure. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create a serene scene. The composition guides the viewer's eye from the detailed foreground through the trees and barn to the vague outline of the distant terrain.

artworks.title: Dance of Death I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 8.7 x 6.5 cm (3 7/16 x 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a skeletal figure playing a drum next to a woman and a man in elaborate attire. In the background, there is a town with medieval architecture and a clock tower. A small curly-haired animal is present in the lower foreground. The style includes hatching and cross-hatching techniques typical of Renaissance printmaking.

artworks.title: The Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession scene with architectural elements. A central figure is riding an animal, surrounded by a crowd. The background includes towers and domes of a city. The crowd includes figures holding palm branches. Palm trees are in the foreground, framing the procession. The linework is detailed and suggestive of a historical or religious theme.

artworks.title: Entrée du Village
artworks.description: The image shows a European townscape with steeply gabled half-timbered buildings, textured clouds, people on wooden walkways, and a monochromatic color palette creating a vintage effect. The intricate strokes depict detailed architecture and a bustling atmosphere bustling.

artworks.title: Hommage à Tolstoï
artworks.description: The image features soft, swirling lines and shapes on a dark background. The shapes resemble human faces and hands, appearing to float or emerge from the shadows. The elongated strokes evoke movement, akin to wisps of smoke or flowing fabric. The composition holds an abstract quality, reminiscent of captured visions or fleeting dreams.

artworks.title: Afbeelding en waarachtigh Verhaal... (Representation of the True Story of Johan de Witt...)
artworks.medium: etching and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a town square. The detailed scene shows a conflict with figures clashing, some holding weapons. Above, there are two medallion portraits surrounded by martial imagery. The bottom of the image contains paragraphs of text in different languages. The drawing is detailed, depicting action in a historical setting.

artworks.title: No Monarchy, No Popery
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex historical scene depicted through multiple panels. The artwork consists of several vignettes or small scenes, each capturing different moments. There is a central panel surrounded by smaller, complementary illustrations. Text is incorporated into the design. Architectural and maritime elements are present, with ships and buildings. The space appears to be filled with details showcasing historical clothing, vessels, and cityscapes. An elaborate border ties these elements together.

artworks.title: De Derde Zee-slagh (The Third Sea Battle)
artworks.medium: etching and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a naval battle scene from a high vantage point, showing the action at sea. The horizon is high in the composition, obscured by ships and cannon fire smoke. The linework is detailed, capturing the ships' movements and battle energy. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on black and white shades to highlight contrast and detail. Ships are engaged in battle with detailed masts and sails. In the distance, more ships and explosions can be seen. A decorative banner above the scene adds graphic design. Below, Dutch text provides context about the Third Anglo-Dutch Sea Battle in 1673.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of muscular figures, some wielding weapons and others displaying intense emotions. The figures are engaging in a dynamic and chaotic scene, with some holding infants or small objects. The composition is detailed and in a classicist style, reminiscent of works from the Renaissance or Baroque periods.

artworks.title: Haystacks, Ipswich
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a field of small wildflowers, two haystacks, a lone tree near the horizon, and an overcast sky with muted colors.

artworks.title: Cascade dessus Wasserberg (Waterfall above Wasserberg)
artworks.medium: watercolor and black ink on laid paper, mounted on original album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high vantage point looking across to a rocky cliff. A rocky ledge with sparse grassy patches and a small tree is in the foreground, where two figures stand. One figure gestures upwards towards a tall waterfall cascading down from the right side. The horizon is obscured by the rugged cliff face, and the sky above is filled with clouds in beige, gray, and light blue tones. The painting features smooth brushstrokes, especially in the waterfall, which shines with white and gray hues. The color palette includes earthy tones, greens, browns, and cool colors of the sky and waterfall.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of Antique Ruins with a Watermill
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a large structure made of wooden beams and brick, looking out onto a rustic scene. There is a misty gray sky in the distance and various materials like wood, stone, and foliage are depicted with realistic brushstrokes. The color palette is warm and earthy, and there are decorative carvings on a column close to us, with laundry hanging to dry. In the distance, there is a mill with cascading water and a figure by the water's edge.

artworks.title: Louis Quinze, Roy de France (Louis XV)
artworks.medium: chalk manner, stipple, and soft-ground etching printed in red ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III and Gregory E. Mescha in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: This image shows a waist-up portrait of a man looking forward. He has distinct facial features, including a strong nose, full lips, and arched eyebrows. His hair is styled in a classical manner with curls framing the sides, appearing grey or aged white. He wears an elaborate outfit typical of the 18th century, with a high-collared shirt with ruffles at the neckline and a sash-like garment draped over his shoulder, adorned with intricate detailing. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is an oval-shaped area with a textured pattern, resembling the frame of an engraved portrait.

artworks.title: Rococo Altar with a Reliquary Tomb
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design featuring detailed sculptural elements. The composition highlights a grandiose and intricate piece of architecture adorned with baroque and rococo decorations. At the center is an empty niche with an elaborately carved archway, surrounded by cherub-like figures and swirling acanthus leaves. Flanking each side of the niche are sculptural figures standing under classical-style pediments. These figures are intricately carved and draped in flowing garments. The drawing is executed in fine lines and shading, providing depth and texture to the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Embracing Lovers in Classical Dress / A Woman in Classical Dress Looking Up
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, black chalk and white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures embracing on a draped surface. Both individuals have curly hair, are facing the left, and are dressed in flowing garments. They appear to be in an intimate embrace, with one figure looking up and the other gazing at them. The background features drapery and vague shapes in shades of gray and blue.

artworks.title: Scène de Marché au Port de l'Hôtel de Ville, Paris (Market Scene at the Port of the Hôtel de Ville, Paris)
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a cobblestone street market with blurred architecture in the background. The image captures an outdoor market scene with various baskets and market goods spread out in the foreground. There is a small wooden structure in the image that resembles a stall or a kiosk. The background is dominated by tall buildings that appear to be of old European architectural style.

artworks.title: The Corpse (Study for The Dead Christ)
artworks.medium: black chalk on buff paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a male figure lying on his back. The man is drawn flat with arms resting by his sides, hands partially closed. Details include closed eyes, a mustached face, and short wavy hair. The nude figure demonstrates anatomy through shading and lines. Surrounding the main sketch are smaller studies, including versions of the full body and another focusing on the torso and head. The background is a plain paper surface with handwritten notes and measurements.

artworks.title: A Copse of Trees
artworks.medium: brown and black pen and ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a peaceful wooded area seen from a ground-level perspective. Trees dominate the view, with two tall trees at the center. The artwork features detailed brushwork using stippling and hatching techniques to create texture. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones, hinting at a late afternoon or early evening light. Rocks and branches are scattered in the foreground, with dense foliage framing the scene.

artworks.title: Noah and the Animals Entering the Ark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with various animals. The image depicts farm animals, including sheep, goats, and dogs, gathered around an elderly figure with a staff. The animals are interacting with each other or with the central figure in a rustic setting. The sketch features fine lines and light shading for texture and depth, especially in the wool of the sheep and the figure's clothing. The background shows a rural environment with outlines representing trees or foliage. Birds are present, adding movement to the scene. The drawing style is classical and detailed, capturing the gentle atmosphere of rural life.
